The figure isn't visible to me, so I'm assuming the standard picture: a strip of 10 triangles in a row, each sharing an edge with the next. This is a path of 10 triangles with 9 shared edges.

Dividing the bar into contiguous pieces means choosing which of the 9 shared edges to cut. Each subset of cuts gives a distinct division, and each piece is automatically contiguous. That gives 2^9 = 512 subsets. Removing the empty subset (no cuts, so only one piece) leaves 511 divisions into two or more pieces.

ANSWER: 511
